description: Recognizes an explicit retrospective request even when the earlier transcript contains enticing packaging work.
prompt: Why did my previous Thistledown Charts chat with the AI go off the rails? Review the transcript, separate the useful advice from the detour, and suggest a better way to ask next time.

paraphrases.novice: Please look back through my Thistledown Charts conversation. Why did the assistant start proposing things I hadn't asked for, was any of its advice useful, and how could I word my next request better?
paraphrases.terse: Thistledown previous AI chat review. Explain detour and improve next request.
